records.literal_gloss: And became king Jehoshaphat his son in his place, and he strengthened himself against Israel.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and he strengthened himself against Israel.
en.B: His son Jehoshaphat became king in his place, and he made himself strong against Israel.
en.R: Asa's son Jehoshaphat became king after him. He built up his strength against the kingdom of Israel.

es.L: Y reinó en su lugar Josafat su hijo, y se hizo fuerte contra Israel.
es.B: Su hijo Josafat reinó en su lugar, y se fortaleció frente a Israel.
es.R: Josafat, el hijo de Asá, lo sucedió como rey. Hizo fuerte su reino frente al reino de Israel.

fr.L: Et Josaphat son fils régna à sa place, et il se fortifia contre Israël.
fr.B: Et Josaphat son fils régna à sa place, et il se rendit fort face à Israël.
fr.R: Son fils Josaphat est devenu roi à sa place. Il a renforcé sa puissance face au royaume d’Israël.

sw.L: Na Yehoshafati mwanawe akatawala mahali pake, akajiimarisha dhidi ya Israeli.
sw.B: Mwanawe Yehoshafati akawa mfalme mahali pake, akajiimarisha dhidi ya Israeli.
sw.R: Mwana wa Asa, Yehoshafati, akawa mfalme mahali pake. Akajenga nguvu zake dhidi ya ufalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát con trai ông trị vì thay ông, và làm cho mình vững mạnh để chống lại Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát con trai vua lên kế vị, và vua củng cố sức mạnh để chống lại Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát con trai A-sa lên kế vị. Vua củng cố lực lượng để đối phó với vương quốc Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 아들 여호사밧이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었고, 그가 이스라엘에 맞서 자신을 강하게 했다.
ko.B: 그의 아들 여호사밧이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다. 그는 이스라엘에 맞서 나라를 강하게 했다.
ko.R: 아사의 아들 여호사밧이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다. 그는 이스라엘 나라에 맞설 수 있도록 힘을 길렀다.

decisions.choice: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place: the same words as 1 Kings 15:24
decisions.reason: The chapter follows straight on from Asa's death and burial (16:13-14). The words match the end of 1 Kings 15:24, and they are given here as there. Kings then says little more about Jehoshaphat until 1 Kings 22:41-51; Chronicles gives four chapters to him (17-20).

decisions.choice: strengthened himself against Israel: made his kingdom strong to stand against the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: The verb means to make oneself strong or to take firm hold. With "against" it points to defense: Asa had fought Baasha of Israel (16:1-6), and the next verse tells how Jehoshaphat put troops in the cities of Judah and of Ephraim. The same words could mean "took firm control over Israel", with "Israel" naming his own people as it sometimes does in Chronicles (compare 1:1; 12:1), but verse 2 favors the sense of standing against the north.

decisions.choice: Israel: the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Since the division of the kingdom (10:16-19), "Israel" usually names the northern kingdom, with its own king, and "Judah" the kingdom ruled from Jerusalem. Ahab was now king of Israel (18:1).

decisions.choice: reigned in his place (Literal); became king in his place (Balanced); became king after him (Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession words are worded as in 1 Kings 15:24. Readable names Asa, so that "his son" is clear at the start of a chapter, and adds "the kingdom of" before Israel.

decisions.choice: the successor formula of the Kings terms note; "Josafat"
decisions.reason: "reinó en su lugar Y su hijo" (L), "Su hijo Y reinó en su lugar" (B), "lo sucedió como rey" (R), as the Spanish of 1 Kings 15:24, with Jehoshaphat in the form the note sets.

decisions.choice: "et Josaphat son fils régna à sa place" (L, B); "son fils Josaphat est devenu roi à sa place" (R)
decisions.reason: The successor formula of the terms note, as at 1 Kings 15:24 in French Kings.

decisions.choice: the successor formula: "Y con trai ông trị vì thay ông" (L), "Y con trai vua lên kế vị" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula of the terms note, as 1 Kings 15:24 (m1); Readable names Asa at the start of a chapter.

decisions.choice: The successor formula of the terms note: "그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다" (L), "그의 아들 X가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same words as 1 Kings 15:24 (m1).

source.text: וַיִּ֨תֶּן־חַ֔יִל בְּכָל־עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה הַבְּצֻר֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֤ן נְצִיבִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד אָסָ֥א אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he put troops in all [the] cities of Judah the fortified, and he put garrisons in [the] land of Judah and in [the] cities of Ephraim which captured Asa his father.

en.L: And he put troops in all the fortified cities of Judah, and he put garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that Asa his father had captured.
en.B: He stationed troops in every fortified city of Judah, and he placed garrisons in the land of Judah and in those Ephraimite towns his father Asa had taken.
en.R: He put soldiers in all the walled towns of Judah. He also put groups of soldiers in the land of Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

es.L: Y puso tropas en todas las ciudades fortificadas de Judá, y puso guarniciones en la tierra de Judá y en las ciudades de Efraín que Asá su padre había tomado.
es.B: Estacionó tropas en todas las ciudades fortificadas de Judá, y puso guarniciones en la tierra de Judá y en las ciudades de Efraín que su padre Asá había conquistado.
es.R: Puso soldados en todos los pueblos amurallados de Judá. También puso grupos de soldados en la tierra de Judá y en los pueblos de Efraín que su padre Asá había conquistado.

fr.L: Et il mit des troupes dans toutes les villes fortes de Juda, et il mit des garnisons dans le pays de Juda et dans les villes d’Éphraïm qu’Asa son père avait prises.
fr.B: Il plaça des troupes dans toutes les villes fortes de Juda, et il établit des garnisons dans le pays de Juda et dans les villes d’Éphraïm que son père Asa avait prises.
fr.R: Il a mis des soldats dans toutes les villes fortifiées de Juda. Il a aussi installé des groupes de soldats dans le pays de Juda et dans les villes d’Éphraïm que son père Asa avait prises.

sw.B: Aliweka askari katika kila mji wenye ngome wa Yuda, akaweka vikosi vya walinzi katika nchi ya Yuda na katika miji ile ya Efraimu ambayo baba yake Asa alikuwa ameiteka.
sw.R: Aliweka askari katika miji yote yenye kuta ya Yuda. Aliweka pia vikundi vya askari katika nchi ya Yuda na katika miji ya Efraimu ambayo baba yake Asa alikuwa ameiteka.

vi.L: Vua đặt quân lính trong tất cả các thành kiên cố của Giu-đa, và đặt các đồn binh trong xứ Giu-đa và trong các thành Ép-ra-im mà A-sa cha vua đã chiếm.
vi.B: Vua đóng quân tại mọi thành kiên cố của Giu-đa, và đặt các đồn binh trong xứ Giu-đa và trong các thành của Ép-ra-im mà A-sa cha vua đã chiếm được.
vi.R: Vua đặt binh lính trong tất cả các thành có tường bao quanh của Giu-đa. Vua cũng đặt những toán quân trấn giữ trong xứ Giu-đa và trong các thành của Ép-ra-im mà A-sa cha vua đã chiếm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 유다의 모든 요새 성읍에 군대를 두었고, 유다 땅과 그의 아버지 아사가 빼앗은 에브라임 성읍들에 수비대를 두었다.
ko.B: 그는 유다의 모든 요새 성읍에 군대를 배치하고, 유다 땅과 그의 아버지 아사가 빼앗은 에브라임 성읍들에 수비대를 두었다.
ko.R: 그는 성벽으로 둘러싸인 유다의 모든 성읍에 군인들을 두었다. 그리고 유다 땅과 그의 아버지 아사가 빼앗은 에브라임의 성읍들에도 지키는 군인들을 두었다.

decisions.choice: garrisons: bodies of troops stationed to hold a place
decisions.reason: The word can mean a garrison, or an officer or governor set over a region (1 Kings 4:19). Beside "troops" in the first half of the verse, it most likely names units of soldiers placed to hold the land, as David placed garrisons in Aram and Edom (1 Chronicles 18:6, 13).

decisions.choice: the cities of Ephraim that Asa had captured: towns taken in the border wars with Israel
decisions.reason: Chronicles has already said that Asa held towns he had taken in the hill country of Ephraim (15:8). Abijah too had taken towns from Israel (13:19). These border towns needed troops to hold them.

decisions.choice: troops: a body of soldiers
decisions.reason: The word means strength, and so also an army or force of soldiers. Here it is the troops Jehoshaphat placed in the walled towns.

decisions.choice: walled towns; groups of soldiers
decisions.reason: Readable says "walled towns" for fortified cities, as at 12:4, and explains "garrisons" as groups of soldiers, as at 1 Chronicles 18:6.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י הָלַ֗ךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֞י דָּוִ֤יד אָבִיו֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א דָרַ֖שׁ לַבְּעָלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And was Yahweh with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in [the] ways of David his father the first, and not he sought [the] Baals,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the earlier ways of David his father, and he did not seek the Baals,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was with Jehoshaphat, because he followed the earlier ways of his ancestor David and did not seek the Baals,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was with Jehoshaphat, because he lived as his ancestor David had lived in his earlier years. He did not look to the Baals.

es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estuvo con Josafat, porque siguió los primeros caminos de su antepasado David y no buscó a los baales,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estuvo con Josafat, porque vivió como había vivido su antepasado David en sus primeros años. No buscó la ayuda de los baales.

fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fut avec Josaphat, car il suivit les premières voies de son ancêtre David et ne rechercha pas les Baals,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec Josaphat, parce qu’il vivait comme son ancêtre David avait vécu dans ses premières années. Il ne s’est pas tourné vers les Baals.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với Giô-sa-phát, vì ông bước đi theo các đường lối trước kia của Đa-vít cha ông, và không tìm cầu các Ba-anh,
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với Giô-sa-phát, vì vua đi theo các đường lối thuở trước của Đa-vít tổ tiên mình và không tìm cầu các Ba-anh,
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với Giô-sa-phát, vì vua sống như Đa-vít tổ tiên mình đã sống trong những năm đầu. Vua không tìm đến các thần Ba-anh.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호사밧과 함께 계셨다. 그가 그의 조상 다윗의 처음 길로 걸었고, 바알들을 찾지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호사밧과 함께 계셨다. 그가 그의 조상 다윗이 처음에 걷던 길을 따랐고, 바알들을 찾지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호사밧과 함께 계셨다. 그가 그의 조상 다윗이 젊었을 때 살았던 것처럼 살았기 때문이다. 그는 바알 신들에게 기대지 않았다.

decisions.choice: the earlier ways of David his father: the Hebrew text, with the name David
alternatives: the earlier ways of his father (Asa)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text names David. The ancient Greek translation does not have the name and reads "the earlier ways of his father", which would mean Asa in the good years of his reign (chapters 14-15), before the failures of chapter 16. The Hebrew reading is kept here: Chronicles often holds up David as the model for the kings after him (29:2; 34:2-3).

decisions.choice: earlier ways: the way David lived in his earlier years, or in the former days
alternatives: the ways of David in former days
decisions.reason: "Earlier" describes the ways. With David's name it may set David's early faithfulness against his later failures, such as the census (1 Chronicles 21:1-8), or it may simply mean the ways of David in the days of old, the first king of the line. The text does not say which.

decisions.choice: seek: turn to in worship and for help
decisions.reason: "Seek" is a key word in Chronicles for a king's loyalty: to seek Yahweh is to look to him, worship him and depend on him (1 Chronicles 10:13-14; 2 Chronicles 12:14; 15:2). Jehoshaphat did not look to the Baals in this way.

decisions.choice: the Baals: the god Baal in his many local forms
decisions.reason: Baal, "lord" or "owner", was the storm and fertility god of Canaan. The plural speaks of the god as he was worshiped at many places and under many titles (Judges 2:11). In the north, Ahab had built a temple for Baal in Samaria (1 Kings 16:31-32).

decisions.choice: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: David was Jehoshaphat's ancestor, several generations back. Literal keeps "father"; Balanced and Readable say "ancestor" so that no reader takes David for Asa.

decisions.choice: look to
decisions.reason: Readable says "look to" for "seek", as at 1 Chronicles 10:14, and closes the sentence here; the next record goes on with "Instead".

decisions.choice: "David su padre" (L); "su antepasado David" (B, R); "los baales"
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): David is Jehoshaphat's ancestor; the plural Baals are "los baales", the god in his local forms (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "tổ tiên" (B, R) for David
decisions.reason: David was Jehoshaphat's ancestor several generations back; Literal keeps "cha" as the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "các Ba-anh" (L, B); "các thần Ba-anh" (R)
decisions.reason: Baal in his many local forms (m4), with the name of the terms note.

decisions.choice: "그의 조상 다윗" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his father"; David is Jehoshaphat's ancestor, and Korean "조상" says so, as the Korean Kings does at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: כִּ֠י לֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י אָבִיו֙ דָּרָ֔שׁ וּבְמִצְוֺתָ֖יו הָלָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֖א כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: but [to the] God of his father he sought, and in his commandments he walked, and not according to [the] practice of Israel.

en.L: but he sought the God of his father, and he walked in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, and not according to the practice of Israel.
en.B: but sought the God of his father and followed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, and did not act as Israel did.
en.R: Instead, he looked to the God his father had served, and he obeyed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands. He did not do the things the people of the kingdom of Israel did.

es.L: sino que buscó al Dios de su padre, y anduvo en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, y no según las obras de Israel.
es.B: sino que buscó al Dios de su padre y siguió {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, y no hizo como hacía Israel.
es.R: En cambio, buscó al Dios a quien su padre había servido, y obedeció {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos. No hizo las cosas que hacía la gente del reino de Israel.

fr.L: mais il rechercha le Dieu de son père, et il marcha dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, et non selon la conduite d’Israël.
fr.B: mais il rechercha le Dieu de son père et suivit {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, sans agir comme Israël.
fr.R: Au contraire, il s’est tourné vers le Dieu que son père avait servi, et il a obéi à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements. Il n’a pas fait ce que faisaient les gens du royaume d’Israël.

sw.L: bali alimtafuta Mungu wa baba yake, akaenda katika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, wala si kwa kufuata matendo ya Israeli.
sw.B: bali alimtafuta Mungu wa baba yake na kufuata amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, wala hakutenda kama Israeli walivyotenda.
sw.R: Badala yake, alimwelekea Mungu ambaye baba yake alimtumikia, akatii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Hakufanya mambo ambayo watu wa ufalme wa Israeli walifanya.

vi.L: nhưng ông tìm cầu Đức Chúa Trời của cha mình, và bước đi theo các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chứ không theo cách làm của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: nhưng tìm cầu Đức Chúa Trời của cha mình và làm theo các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không làm như Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Trái lại, vua tìm đến Đức Chúa Trời mà cha vua đã thờ phượng, và vâng giữ các mệnh lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vua không làm những điều dân vương quốc Y-sơ-ra-ên làm.

ko.L: 오히려 그는 그의 아버지의 하나님을 찾고 그분의 계명 안에서 걸었으며, 이스라엘의 행위를 따르지 않았다.
ko.B: 오히려 그는 그의 아버지의 하나님을 찾고 그분의 계명을 따랐으며, 이스라엘이 하는 대로 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 오히려 그는 그의 아버지가 섬기던 하나님을 찾고 그분의 명령에 순종했다. 그는 이스라엘 나라 사람들이 하는 일을 따라 하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: but he sought the God of his father: in contrast to the Baals
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "the God of his father" first, for emphasis: not the Baals (verse 3), but his father's God. "His father" may be Asa, who called Judah to seek Yahweh (14:3; 15:12), or David of verse 3; both served the same God.

decisions.choice: the practice of Israel: the worship of the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: From its first king the northern kingdom worshiped at the golden calves of Bethel and Dan (1 Kings 12:28-33; 2 Chronicles 13:8-9), and under Ahab it served Baal (1 Kings 16:31-33). Jehoshaphat kept apart from these practices.

decisions.choice: commandments (Balanced); commands (Readable); did not act as Israel did
decisions.reason: The word for commandments follows the table used since Exodus: Balanced "commandments", Readable "commands". Balanced turns "not according to the practice of Israel" into a short clause; Readable adds "the people of the kingdom of" so that the northern kingdom is meant.

source.text: וַיָּ֨כֶן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֧וּ כָל־יְהוּדָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וַֽיְהִי־ל֥וֹ עֹֽשֶׁר־וְכָב֖וֹד לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And established Yahweh the kingdom in his hand, and gave all Judah tribute to Jehoshaphat, and was to him riches and honor in abundance.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} established the kingdom in his hand, and all Judah gave tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made the kingdom secure under his rule. All Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, and he had great riches and honor.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made Jehoshaphat's rule over the kingdom firm. All the people of Judah brought him gifts, and he became very rich and highly honored.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} afirmó el reino en su mano, y todo Judá dio presentes a Josafat, y tuvo riquezas y gloria en abundancia.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} afirmó el reino bajo su gobierno. Todo Judá le llevaba presentes a Josafat, y tuvo grandes riquezas y gloria.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} afirmó el gobierno de Josafat sobre el reino. Todo el pueblo de Judá le llevaba regalos, y llegó a ser muy rico y muy honrado.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} affermit la royauté dans sa main, et tout Juda donna un tribut à Josaphat, et il eut des richesses et de la gloire en abondance.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} affermit le royaume entre ses mains. Tout Juda apportait des présents à Josaphat, et il eut de grandes richesses et beaucoup de gloire.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rendu solide le pouvoir de Josaphat sur le royaume. Tout le peuple de Juda lui apportait des cadeaux, et il est devenu très riche et très honoré.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akauthibitisha ufalme mkononi mwake, na Yuda wote wakampa Yehoshafati kodi, naye akawa na utajiri na heshima kwa wingi.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliuimarisha ufalme chini ya utawala wake. Yuda wote walimletea Yehoshafati zawadi, naye akawa na utajiri mwingi na heshima kubwa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliufanya utawala wa Yehoshafati juu ya ufalme kuwa imara. Watu wote wa Yuda walimletea zawadi, naye akawa tajiri sana na mwenye heshima kubwa.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm vững vương quốc trong tay ông, và cả Giu-đa dâng cống phẩm cho Giô-sa-phát, và ông có giàu có và vinh hiển rất nhiều.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho vương quốc được vững chắc dưới quyền vua. Cả Giu-đa đều dâng lễ vật cho Giô-sa-phát, và vua được rất giàu có và vinh hiển.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho quyền cai trị của Giô-sa-phát trên vương quốc được vững chắc. Toàn dân Giu-đa đem quà đến dâng vua, và vua trở nên rất giàu có và được tôn trọng.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 손에서 나라를 굳게 하셨고, 온 유다가 여호사밧에게 예물을 바쳤다. 그리고 그에게 부와 영예가 많았다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 다스림 아래 나라를 든든하게 하셨다. 온 유다가 여호사밧에게 예물을 바쳤고, 그는 큰 부와 영예를 누렸다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호사밧이 나라를 든든하게 다스리게 하셨다. 유다의 모든 백성이 그에게 예물을 가져왔다. 그래서 그는 아주 부유해지고 큰 존경을 받았다.

decisions.choice: established the kingdom in his hand: made his rule over it secure
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power and control. Yahweh made the kingdom firm under Jehoshaphat's rule, as he had promised to establish the kingdom of David's line (1 Chronicles 17:11; 2 Chronicles 1:1).

decisions.choice: tribute: gifts brought to the king
decisions.reason: The word means a gift or offering. Brought by a king's own people, it is a sign of loyalty and honor, as when some despised Saul and brought him no gift (1 Samuel 10:27). From foreign peoples it is tribute (verse 11).

decisions.choice: riches and honor in abundance: blessing for faithfulness
decisions.reason: Chronicles uses "riches and honor" for the blessing God gave David (1 Chronicles 29:28) and Solomon (2 Chronicles 1:12). The same is said of Jehoshaphat again at 18:1.

decisions.choice: gifts
decisions.reason: Since these come from Jehoshaphat's own people, Balanced and Readable say "gifts"; Literal keeps "tribute".

decisions.choice: "riquezas y gloria" (L, B); "muy rico y muy honrado" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:11-12: *kavod* is "gloria" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says what it means for a king.

source.text: וַיִּגְבַּ֥הּ לִבּ֖וֹ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְע֗וֹד הֵסִ֛יר אֶת־הַבָּמ֥וֹת וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִ֖ים מִיהוּדָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And was high his heart in [the] ways of Yahweh, and further he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.

en.L: And his heart was high in the ways of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and moreover he removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.
en.B: His heart was bold in the ways of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he also removed the high places and the Asherah poles from Judah.
en.R: He was eager and bold in following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s ways. He also removed the hilltop shrines and the poles used to worship Asherah from Judah.

es.L: Y se elevó su corazón en los caminos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y además quitó de Judá los lugares altos y los postes de Aserá.
es.B: Su corazón se animó en los caminos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y además quitó de Judá los lugares altos y los postes de Aserá.
es.R: Siguió con entusiasmo y valor los caminos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. También quitó de Judá los santuarios sobre las colinas y los postes que se usaban para adorar a la diosa Aserá.

fr.L: Et son cœur s’éleva dans les voies {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et de plus il ôta de Juda les hauts lieux et les poteaux d’Ashéra.
fr.B: Son cœur fut plein d’ardeur dans les voies {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il supprima aussi de Juda les hauts lieux et les poteaux d’Ashéra.
fr.R: Il était plein d’ardeur et de courage pour suivre les chemins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il a aussi enlevé de Juda les sanctuaires sur les collines et les poteaux qui servaient à adorer la déesse Ashéra.

sw.L: Moyo wake ukainuka katika njia za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na tena akaondoa mahali pa juu na miti ya Ashera katika Yuda.
sw.B: Moyo wake ulikuwa na ujasiri katika njia za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye akaondoa pia mahali pa juu na miti ya Ashera katika Yuda.
sw.R: Alikuwa na bidii na ujasiri katika kufuata njia za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akaondoa pia katika Yuda patakatifu pa kilimani na miti iliyotumika kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera.

vi.L: Lòng ông cao lên trong các đường lối của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và ông còn dẹp bỏ các nơi cao và các trụ A-sê-ra khỏi Giu-đa.
vi.B: Lòng vua mạnh dạn trong các đường lối của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và vua còn dẹp bỏ các nơi cao và các trụ A-sê-ra khỏi Giu-đa.
vi.R: Vua hăng hái và mạnh dạn đi theo đường lối của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua cũng dẹp bỏ các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao và các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra khỏi Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 마음이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 길에서 높아졌다. 그리고 그가 다시 유다에서 산당들과 아세라 목상들을 없앴다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 길을 따르는 데 담대했다. 그는 또 유다에서 산당들과 아세라 목상들을 없앴다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 길을 따르는 일에 열심이고 용감했다. 그는 또 유다에서 산꼭대기 제단들과 아세라 여신을 섬기는 목상들을 없앴다.

decisions.choice: his heart was high: he was bold and eager in Yahweh's ways
decisions.reason: A "high" or lifted-up heart usually means pride, and Chronicles uses it that way of Uzziah and Hezekiah (26:16; 32:25; compare Proverbs 16:5). Here it is "in the ways of Yahweh", and the whole passage praises the king, so the sense is courage and zeal for Yahweh: his spirit was lifted up to serve him.

decisions.choice: he removed the high places: yet 20:33 says the high places were not removed
alternatives: he removed only the shrines of other gods
decisions.reason: Later Chronicles says that under Jehoshaphat "the high places were not removed" (20:33), as Kings does (1 Kings 22:44). The same tension appears with Asa (14:2, 4 and 15:17). The removal here goes with the Asherah poles, so it may mean the shrines to other gods, while high places where people worshiped Yahweh stayed; or the king's work may not have lasted, and the people went back to them. The text does not explain.

decisions.choice: the high places and the Asherah poles: local shrines, and wooden poles for the goddess Asherah
decisions.reason: High places were local places of worship, often on hills, with an altar. Asherah was a Canaanite goddess, and wooden poles or trees set up at shrines stood for her; the law forbids them (Deuteronomy 16:21).

decisions.choice: moreover: in addition, or again
decisions.reason: The word can add one more thing ("moreover") or mean "again", recalling that Asa had already removed such shrines (14:2, 4). Either way, removing them is a further sign of the king's zeal.

decisions.choice: bold (Balanced); eager and bold (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture "his heart was high"; Balanced and Readable say what it means here, so that no reader takes it as pride (m1).

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines; poles used to worship Asherah
decisions.reason: Readable uses the wording these books use throughout for high places and Asherah poles.

decisions.choice: "se elevó su corazón" (L); "su corazón se animó" (B); "con entusiasmo y valor" (R)
decisions.reason: A lifted heart usually means pride, but here it is boldness in Yahweh's ways (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable avoid a word for pride.

decisions.choice: "lòng ... cao lên" (L); "mạnh dạn" (B); "hăng hái và mạnh dạn" (R)
decisions.reason: The picture of a high heart here means boldness in God's ways, not pride (m1); Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "마음이 ... 높아졌다" (L), "담대했다" (B), "열심이고 용감했다" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the idiom means boldness in the LORD's ways (m1), not pride; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁל֜וֹשׁ לְמָלְכ֗וֹ שָׁלַ֤ח לְשָׂרָיו֙ לְבֶן־חַ֨יִל֙ וּלְעֹבַדְיָ֣ה וְלִזְכַרְיָ֔ה וְלִנְתַנְאֵ֖ל וּלְמִיכָיָ֑הוּ לְלַמֵּ֖ד בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And in [the] year three of his reigning he sent to his princes, to Ben-hail and to Obadiah and to Zechariah and to Nethanel and to Micaiah, to teach in [the] cities of Judah;

en.L: And in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, Ben-hail and Obadiah and Zechariah and Nethanel and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah,
en.B: In the third year of his reign he sent out his officials to teach in the cities of Judah: Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah.
en.R: In the third year that Jehoshaphat was king, he sent some of his leaders to teach in the towns of Judah. They were Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah.

es.L: Y en el año tercero de su reinado envió a sus príncipes, a Ben-hail y a Abdías y a Zacarías y a Natanael y a Micaías, para que enseñaran en las ciudades de Judá,
es.B: En el tercer año de su reinado envió a sus jefes a enseñar en las ciudades de Judá: Ben-hail, Abdías, Zacarías, Natanael y Micaías.
es.R: En el tercer año de su reinado, Josafat envió a algunos de sus líderes a enseñar en los pueblos de Judá. Eran Ben-hail, Abdías, Zacarías, Natanael y Micaías.

fr.L: Et en la troisième année de son règne, il envoya ses princes, Ben-Haïl, et Abdias, et Zacharie, et Netanel, et Michée, pour enseigner dans les villes de Juda,
fr.B: La troisième année de son règne, il envoya ses hauts fonctionnaires enseigner dans les villes de Juda : Ben-Haïl, Abdias, Zacharie, Netanel et Michée.
fr.R: Pendant la troisième année de son règne, Josaphat a envoyé certains de ses dirigeants enseigner dans les villes de Juda. C’étaient Ben-Haïl, Abdias, Zacharie, Netanel et Michée.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa kutawala kwake akawatuma wakuu wake, Ben-haili na Obadia na Zekaria na Nethaneli na Mikaya, kufundisha katika miji ya Yuda,
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wake aliwatuma maafisa wake kufundisha katika miji ya Yuda: Ben-haili, Obadia, Zekaria, Nethaneli na Mikaya.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wake, Yehoshafati aliwatuma baadhi ya viongozi wake kufundisha katika miji ya Yuda. Hao walikuwa Ben-haili, Obadia, Zekaria, Nethaneli na Mikaya.

vi.L: Năm thứ ba triều đại mình, vua sai các quan trưởng của mình là Bên-Hai-in, Áp-đia, Xa-cha-ri, Nê-tha-nên và Mi-chê đi dạy dỗ trong các thành của Giu-đa,
vi.B: Năm thứ ba triều đại mình, vua sai các quan chức đi dạy dỗ trong các thành của Giu-đa: Bên-Hai-in, Áp-đia, Xa-cha-ri, Nê-tha-nên và Mi-chê.
vi.R: Năm thứ ba Giô-sa-phát làm vua, vua sai một số nhà lãnh đạo đi dạy dỗ trong các thành của Giu-đa. Đó là Bên-Hai-in, Áp-đia, Xa-cha-ri, Nê-tha-nên và Mi-chê.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 통치 제3년에 그가 그의 고관들, 곧 벤하일과 오바댜와 스가랴와 느다넬과 미가야를 보내어 유다 성읍들에서 가르치게 했다.
ko.B: 그는 다스린 지 3년째 되는 해에 고관들을 보내 유다 성읍들에서 가르치게 했다. 그들은 벤하일과 오바댜와 스가랴와 느다넬과 미가야였다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 왕이 된 지 3년째 되는 해에 지도자 몇 사람을 보내 유다 성읍들에서 가르치게 했다. 그들은 벤하일과 오바댜와 스가랴와 느다넬과 미가야였다.

decisions.choice: Ben-hail: a man's name
decisions.reason: The name means "son of strength". It stands first in a list of names joined by "and", so it is read as the name of one of the officials. Some have read it as a description, "his officials, men of ability", but the pattern of the list favors a name.

decisions.choice: he sent his officials: the officials are the ones sent
decisions.reason: The Hebrew marks each name with a small word that can mean "to", but here it marks the people sent, as it often does in the later Hebrew of Chronicles. The king did not send a message to them; he sent them out to teach.

decisions.choice: officials sent to teach: the king's authority behind the teaching
decisions.reason: Teaching the law was the work of priests and Levites (verse 8; Deuteronomy 33:10). By sending his own officials with them, the king put the weight of his rule behind the teaching. "The third year of his reign" may count from when he began to reign alone.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word for high officials follows one table across these books: Literal "princes", Balanced "officials", Readable "leaders".

decisions.choice: the names in a second sentence
decisions.reason: Readable says what they were sent to do first and lists the names after, to keep the sentence short.

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L); "jefes" (B); "líderes" (R); the names in their usual Spanish forms
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): the princes are the king's officials; Obadiah and Micaiah take the forms of the Kings terms note.

decisions.choice: "Ben-Haïl, Abdias, Zacharie, Netanel et Michée"
decisions.reason: Names already in these books or the New Testament take their usual French form (Abdias, Zacharie, Michée), as the terms note gives Abdias and Michée for the same Hebrew names in Kings; the others follow the same spelling pattern.

source.text: וְעִמָּהֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֗ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָ֡הוּ וּנְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וּזְבַדְיָ֡הוּ וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽיהוֹנָתָן֩ וַאֲדֹ֨נִיָּ֧הוּ וְטֽוֹבִיָּ֛הוּ וְט֥וֹב אֲדוֹנִיָּ֖ה הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וִֽיהוֹרָ֖ם הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and with them the Levites: Shemaiah and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Asahel and Shemiramoth and Jehonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram the priests.

en.L: and with them [were] the Levites: Shemaiah and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Asahel and Shemiramoth and Jehonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
en.B: With them were the Levites Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob-adonijah, and with them the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
en.R: With them went these Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob-adonijah. The priests Elishama and Jehoram also went with them.

es.L: y con ellos [estaban] los levitas: Semaías y Netanías y Zebadías y Asael y Semiramot y Jehonatán y Adonías y Tobías y Tob-adonías, los levitas; y con ellos Elisama y Jehoram, los sacerdotes.
es.B: Con ellos estaban los levitas Semaías, Netanías, Zebadías, Asael, Semiramot, Jehonatán, Adonías, Tobías y Tob-adonías, y con ellos los sacerdotes Elisama y Jehoram.
es.R: Con ellos fueron estos levitas: Semaías, Netanías, Zebadías, Asael, Semiramot, Jehonatán, Adonías, Tobías y Tob-adonías. Los sacerdotes Elisama y Jehoram también fueron con ellos.

fr.L: et avec eux [étaient] les Lévites : Shemaya, et Netania, et Zebadia, et Asahel, et Shemiramoth, et Yehonathan, et Adonias, et Tobiya, et Tob-Adoniya, les Lévites ; et avec eux Élishama et Yehoram, les prêtres.
fr.B: Avec eux, il y avait les Lévites Shemaya, Netania, Zebadia, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Yehonathan, Adonias, Tobiya et Tob-Adoniya, et avec eux les prêtres Élishama et Yehoram.
fr.R: Ces Lévites sont partis avec eux : Shemaya, Netania, Zebadia, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Yehonathan, Adonias, Tobiya et Tob-Adoniya. Les prêtres Élishama et Yehoram sont aussi partis avec eux.

sw.L: na pamoja nao [walikuwa] Walawi: Shemaya na Nethania na Zebadia na Asaheli na Shemiramothi na Yehonathani na Adoniya na Tobia na Tob-adoniya, Walawi; na pamoja nao Elishama na Yehoramu, makuhani.
sw.B: Pamoja nao walikuwa Walawi Shemaya, Nethania, Zebadia, Asaheli, Shemiramothi, Yehonathani, Adoniya, Tobia na Tob-adoniya, na pamoja nao makuhani Elishama na Yehoramu.
sw.R: Pamoja nao walikwenda Walawi hawa: Shemaya, Nethania, Zebadia, Asaheli, Shemiramothi, Yehonathani, Adoniya, Tobia na Tob-adoniya. Makuhani Elishama na Yehoramu walikwenda pamoja nao pia.

vi.L: và với họ [có] những người Lê-vi: Sê-ma-gia, Nê-tha-nia, Xê-ba-đia, A-sa-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hô-na-than, A-đô-ni-gia, Tô-bi-gia và Tô-bát A-đô-ni-gia, những người Lê-vi; và với họ có Ê-li-sa-ma và Giê-hô-ram, các thầy tế lễ.
vi.B: Cùng đi với họ có những người Lê-vi là Sê-ma-gia, Nê-tha-nia, Xê-ba-đia, A-sa-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hô-na-than, A-đô-ni-gia, Tô-bi-gia và Tô-bát A-đô-ni-gia, cùng các thầy tế lễ Ê-li-sa-ma và Giê-hô-ram.
vi.R: Những người Lê-vi sau đây đi cùng họ: Sê-ma-gia, Nê-tha-nia, Xê-ba-đia, A-sa-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hô-na-than, A-đô-ni-gia, Tô-bi-gia và Tô-bát A-đô-ni-gia. Các thầy tế lễ Ê-li-sa-ma và Giê-hô-ram cũng đi với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들과 함께 레위인들, 곧 스마야와 느다냐와 스바댜와 아사헬과 스미라못과 여호나단과 아도니야와 도비야와 도바도니야 레위인들이 [있었고], 그들과 함께 제사장 엘리사마와 여호람이 [있었다].
ko.B: 그들과 함께 레위인 스마야와 느다냐와 스바댜와 아사헬과 스미라못과 여호나단과 아도니야와 도비야와 도바도니야가 있었고, 제사장 엘리사마와 여호람도 함께 있었다.
ko.R: 레위인들도 그들과 함께 갔다. 그들은 스마야, 느다냐, 스바댜, 아사헬, 스미라못, 여호나단, 아도니야, 도비야, 도바도니야였다. 제사장 엘리사마와 여호람도 그들과 함께 갔다.

decisions.choice: Levites and priests: the teachers of the law
decisions.reason: The law gave the priests and Levites the task of teaching Israel Yahweh's rulings (Leviticus 10:11; Deuteronomy 33:10). Here nine Levites and two priests go out with the king's five officials.

decisions.choice: Tob-adonijah: a man's name
decisions.reason: The name means "good is my lord, Yahweh". It joins the two names just before it, Tobijah and Adonijah. It may be a real name, or it may have come about when a copyist repeated those two names; the text as it stands lists it as a ninth Levite.

decisions.choice: Jehonathan
decisions.reason: This is the longer form of the name Jonathan, as the Hebrew spells it here. It keeps the spelling of the source data.

decisions.choice: "the Levites" said once
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the Levites" before and after the list, as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable say it once.

decisions.choice: "Jehonatán", "Tob-adonías", "Jehoram"
decisions.reason: The English keeps the long form Jehonathan, and the Kings terms note keeps Jehoram and Joram apart; Spanish writes "Jehonatán" and "Jehoram" to match.

decisions.choice: "Giê-hô-na-than"; "Tô-bát A-đô-ni-gia"
decisions.reason: The longer spelling of Jonathan is kept apart from "Giô-na-than", as the English keeps Jehonathan; the names follow the usual Protestant forms.

decisions.choice: "여호나단", "도바도니야"
decisions.reason: Each name in its usual Korean form, kept as the Hebrew spells it (Jehonathan, not Jonathan).

source.text: וַֽיְלַמְּדוּ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעִ֨מָּהֶ֔ם סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ בְּכָל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְלַמְּד֖וּ בָּעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they taught in Judah, and with them [the] book of [the] law of Yahweh; and they went around in all [the] cities of Judah and taught among the people.

en.L: And they taught in Judah, and with them [was] the book of the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and they went around through all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
en.B: They taught in Judah, having the book of the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with them. They went around to all the cities of Judah and taught the people.
en.R: They taught in Judah, and they took with them the book of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s teaching. They went to all the towns of Judah and taught the people there.

es.L: Y enseñaron en Judá, y [tenían] con ellos el libro de la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y recorrieron todas las ciudades de Judá y enseñaron al pueblo.
es.B: Enseñaron en Judá, llevando consigo el libro de la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Recorrieron todas las ciudades de Judá y enseñaron al pueblo.
es.R: Enseñaron en Judá, y llevaron con ellos el libro de la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Fueron a todos los pueblos de Judá y enseñaron a la gente de allí.

fr.L: Et ils enseignèrent en Juda, et avec eux [était] le livre de la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et ils parcoururent toutes les villes de Juda et enseignèrent parmi le peuple.
fr.B: Ils enseignèrent en Juda, avec le livre de la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils parcoururent toutes les villes de Juda et enseignèrent le peuple.
fr.R: Ils ont enseigné en Juda, et ils avaient avec eux le livre de l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils sont allés dans toutes les villes de Juda et ils ont enseigné les gens.

sw.L: Wakafundisha katika Yuda, na pamoja nao [kilikuwa] kitabu cha sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; wakazunguka katika miji yote ya Yuda, wakafundisha kati ya watu.
sw.B: Walifundisha katika Yuda, wakiwa na kitabu cha sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walizunguka katika miji yote ya Yuda wakiwafundisha watu.
sw.R: Walifundisha katika Yuda, nao walichukua pamoja nao kitabu cha mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walikwenda katika miji yote ya Yuda na kuwafundisha watu wa huko.

vi.L: Họ dạy dỗ trong Giu-đa, có sách luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với họ; họ đi khắp các thành của Giu-đa và dạy dỗ giữa dân chúng.
vi.B: Họ dạy dỗ trong Giu-đa, mang theo sách luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ đi khắp các thành của Giu-đa mà dạy dỗ dân chúng.
vi.R: Họ dạy dỗ trong Giu-đa và mang theo sách lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ đi đến mọi thành của Giu-đa và dạy dỗ dân chúng ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 유다에서 가르쳤는데, 그들과 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법책이 있었다. 그리고 그들이 유다의 모든 성읍을 두루 다니며 백성 가운데서 가르쳤다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법책을 가지고 유다에서 가르쳤다. 그들은 유다의 모든 성읍을 두루 다니며 백성을 가르쳤다.
ko.R: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 적은 책을 가지고 유다에서 가르쳤다. 그들은 유다의 모든 성읍을 다니며 그곳 백성을 가르쳤다.

decisions.choice: the book of the law of Yahweh: the written instruction given through Moses
decisions.reason: The word for law means instruction: the whole of what Yahweh taught Israel through Moses, not only rules. Moses wrote it in a book to be read to the people (Deuteronomy 31:9-13, 24-26). The book the teachers carried was this written law, in some form of the books of Moses.

decisions.choice: they went around ... and taught among the people: a teaching journey through the land
decisions.reason: The teachers did not wait for people to come to Jerusalem; they traveled from town to town. Jehoshaphat later goes out among the people himself to bring them back to Yahweh (19:4).

decisions.choice: teaching
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy, Readable says "teaching" for the word Literal and Balanced render "law", since it means instruction.

decisions.choice: "el libro de la ley" (L, B); "el libro de la enseñanza" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 2 Kings sets for the book of the law, as the English Readable says "teaching" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "sách luật pháp" (L, B); "sách lời dạy" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's "sách Luật Pháp"; Readable says "lời dạy" for *torah* as the English says "teaching".

decisions.choice: "율법책" (L, B), "가르침을 적은 책" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the book of the Law; Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י׀פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֗ה עַ֚ל כָּל־מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיב֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עִם־יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] dread of Yahweh on all [the] kingdoms of the lands which [were] around Judah, and not they made war with Jehoshaphat.

en.L: And the dread of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was on all the kingdoms of the lands that [were] around Judah, and they did not make war with Jehoshaphat.
en.B: The dread of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was on all the kingdoms of the lands around Judah, so they did not go to war against Jehoshaphat.
en.R: All the kingdoms in the countries around Judah were afraid of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, so none of them went to war against Jehoshaphat.

es.L: Y el terror {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaba sobre todos los reinos de las tierras que [estaban] alrededor de Judá, y no hicieron guerra contra Josafat.
es.B: El terror {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} cayó sobre todos los reinos de las tierras que rodeaban a Judá, así que no le hicieron la guerra a Josafat.
es.R: Todos los reinos de los países que rodeaban a Judá tenían miedo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, así que ninguno de ellos le hizo la guerra a Josafat.

fr.L: Et la terreur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut sur tous les royaumes des pays qui [étaient] autour de Juda, et ils ne firent pas la guerre à Josaphat.
fr.B: La terreur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pesait sur tous les royaumes des pays qui entouraient Juda, et ils ne firent pas la guerre à Josaphat.
fr.R: Tous les royaumes des pays autour de Juda avaient peur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, alors aucun d’eux n’a fait la guerre à Josaphat.

sw.L: Na hofu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ilikuwa juu ya falme zote za nchi zilizozunguka Yuda, wala hawakupigana vita na Yehoshafati.
sw.B: Hofu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ilikuwa juu ya falme zote za nchi zilizozunguka Yuda, kwa hiyo hawakwenda vitani dhidi ya Yehoshafati.
sw.R: Falme zote katika nchi zilizozunguka Yuda zilimwogopa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa hiyo hakuna hata mmoja uliopigana vita na Yehoshafati.

vi.L: Sự kinh hãi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng trên mọi vương quốc của các xứ chung quanh Giu-đa, và họ không gây chiến với Giô-sa-phát.
vi.B: Sự kinh hãi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đè trên mọi vương quốc của các xứ chung quanh Giu-đa, nên họ không gây chiến với Giô-sa-phát.
vi.R: Mọi vương quốc trong các xứ chung quanh Giu-đa đều kinh sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên không nước nào dám gây chiến với Giô-sa-phát.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주시는 두려움이 유다 주변 여러 땅의 모든 나라에 임하여, 그들이 여호사밧과 싸우지 않았다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주시는 두려움이 유다 주변 여러 나라 위에 있어서, 그들은 여호사밧과 싸우러 나서지 못했다.
ko.R: 유다 주변 여러 나라가 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워했다. 그래서 그들 가운데 아무도 여호사밧과 싸우러 오지 않았다.

decisions.choice: the dread of Yahweh: fear of what Yahweh might do
decisions.reason: This is not the reverent "fear of Yahweh" of Proverbs but terror that Yahweh sends on Israel's enemies, so that they do not dare to attack (Genesis 35:5; 2 Chronicles 14:13; 20:29). It shows Yahweh protecting a king who seeks him.

decisions.choice: and they did not make war: the result of the dread
decisions.reason: The "and" joins cause and result: because the nations feared Yahweh, they left Judah in peace. Chronicles often links peace with faithfulness (14:5-6; 15:15).

decisions.choice: were afraid of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable turns the noun "dread" into a verb with the kingdoms as its subject.

source.text: וּמִן־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים מְבִיאִ֧ים לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט מִנְחָ֖ה וְכֶ֣סֶף מַשָּׂ֑א גַּ֣ם הָֽעַרְבִיאִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֥ים לוֹ֙ צֹ֕אן אֵילִ֔ים שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וּשְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּתְיָשִׁ֕ים שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And some of [the] Philistines [were] bringing to Jehoshaphat gifts and silver [as] tribute; also the Arabs [were] bringing to him flocks: rams seven thousand and seven hundred, and male goats seven thousand and seven hundred.

en.L: And some of the Philistines were bringing Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute; the Arabs also were bringing him flocks: 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats.
en.B: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs also brought him flocks: 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats.
en.R: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and paid him silver as tribute. The Arabs brought him animals from their flocks: 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats.

es.L: Y algunos de los filisteos traían a Josafat presentes y plata como tributo; también los árabes le traían ganado: 7700 carneros y 7700 machos cabríos.
es.B: Algunos de los filisteos le traían a Josafat presentes y plata como tributo, y también los árabes le traían ganado: 7700 carneros y 7700 machos cabríos.
es.R: Algunos de los filisteos le llevaban regalos a Josafat y le pagaban plata como tributo. Los árabes le llevaban animales de sus rebaños: 7700 carneros y 7700 machos cabríos.

fr.L: Et une partie des Philistins apportaient à Josaphat des présents et de l’argent [comme] tribut ; les Arabes aussi lui apportaient du petit bétail : 7 700 béliers et 7 700 boucs.
fr.B: Une partie des Philistins apportaient à Josaphat des présents et de l’argent comme tribut, et les Arabes lui apportaient aussi du petit bétail : 7 700 béliers et 7 700 boucs.
fr.R: Certains Philistins apportaient des cadeaux à Josaphat et lui payaient un tribut en argent. Les Arabes lui apportaient des bêtes de leurs troupeaux : 7 700 béliers et 7 700 boucs.

sw.L: Baadhi ya Wafilisti walikuwa wakimletea Yehoshafati zawadi na fedha kama kodi; Waarabu nao walikuwa wakimletea makundi ya wanyama: kondoo dume 7,700 na mbuzi dume 7,700.
sw.B: Baadhi ya Wafilisti walimletea Yehoshafati zawadi na fedha kama kodi, na Waarabu nao walimletea makundi ya wanyama: kondoo dume 7,700 na mbuzi dume 7,700.
sw.R: Baadhi ya Wafilisti walimletea Yehoshafati zawadi na kumlipa fedha kama kodi. Waarabu walimletea wanyama kutoka katika makundi yao: kondoo dume 7,700 na mbuzi dume 7,700.

vi.L: Một số người Phi-li-tin đem đến cho Giô-sa-phát lễ vật và bạc [làm] cống phẩm; người Ả-rập cũng đem đến cho vua các bầy gia súc: 7.700 con chiên đực và 7.700 con dê đực.
vi.B: Một số người Phi-li-tin đem lễ vật và bạc đến nộp cống cho Giô-sa-phát, và người Ả-rập cũng đem đến cho vua các bầy gia súc: 7.700 con chiên đực và 7.700 con dê đực.
vi.R: Một số người Phi-li-tin đem quà đến cho Giô-sa-phát và nộp bạc làm cống phẩm. Người Ả-rập đem đến cho vua các con vật trong bầy của họ: 7.700 con chiên đực và 7.700 con dê đực.

ko.L: 그리고 블레셋 사람들 가운데 몇이 여호사밧에게 예물과 조공으로 은을 가져왔다. 아라비아 사람들도 그에게 가축 떼, 곧 숫양 7,700마리와 숫염소 7,700마리를 가져왔다.
ko.B: 블레셋 사람들 가운데 몇은 여호사밧에게 예물을 바치고 조공으로 은을 가져왔고, 아라비아 사람들도 그에게 숫양 7,700마리와 숫염소 7,700마리를 가져왔다.
ko.R: 블레셋 사람들 가운데 몇은 여호사밧에게 예물을 바치고 조공으로 은을 바쳤다. 아라비아 사람들은 자기 가축 떼 가운데서 숫양 7,700마리와 숫염소 7,700마리를 그에게 가져왔다.

decisions.choice: silver as tribute: silver laid on them as a payment
decisions.reason: The word means a load or burden. With silver it most likely names tribute, a payment imposed on a weaker people. It could also mean "a load of silver", a large amount.

decisions.choice: were bringing: a regular payment
decisions.reason: The verbs are participles, which can describe something that went on over time. The Philistines and Arabs kept paying Jehoshaphat, as subject peoples did.

decisions.choice: the Philistines and the Arabs: neighbors to the west and to the south
decisions.reason: The Philistines held the coastal plain west of Judah. The Arabs were desert tribes to the south and east, who herded sheep and goats (21:16; 26:7). Gifts from both show that Judah's neighbors accepted Jehoshaphat's power (verse 10).

decisions.choice: brought
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the simple past for the ongoing "were bringing"; the sense of repeated payment is noted in m2.

source.text: וַיְהִ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְגָדֵ֖ל עַד־לְמָ֑עְלָה וַיִּ֧בֶן בִּֽיהוּדָ֛ה בִּירָנִיּ֖וֹת וְעָרֵ֥י מִסְכְּנֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And was Jehoshaphat going and becoming great to upward; and he built in Judah fortresses and cities of storage.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat kept growing greater, to a very high degree; and he built in Judah fortresses and cities of storage.
en.B: Jehoshaphat grew steadily more and more powerful, and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
en.R: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful. He built forts in Judah, and towns where supplies were stored.

es.L: Y Josafat iba engrandeciéndose en gran manera; y edificó en Judá fortalezas y ciudades de almacenes.
es.B: Josafat se hacía cada vez más poderoso, y edificó fortalezas y ciudades de almacenes en Judá.
es.R: Josafat llegó a ser cada vez más poderoso. Construyó fuertes en Judá, y pueblos donde se guardaban provisiones.

fr.L: Et Josaphat allait en grandissant jusqu’au plus haut point ; et il bâtit en Juda des forteresses et des villes d’entrepôts.
fr.B: Josaphat devint de plus en plus puissant, et il bâtit en Juda des forteresses et des villes d’entrepôts.
fr.R: Josaphat est devenu de plus en plus puissant. Il a construit des forteresses en Juda, et des villes où l’on gardait des provisions.

sw.L: Yehoshafati akaendelea kuwa mkuu, hata kupita kiasi; akajenga katika Yuda ngome na miji ya ghala.
sw.B: Yehoshafati aliendelea kuwa na nguvu zaidi na zaidi, akajenga ngome na miji ya ghala katika Yuda.
sw.R: Yehoshafati alizidi kuwa na nguvu. Alijenga ngome katika Yuda, na miji alimohifadhi mahitaji.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát cứ ngày càng lớn mạnh lên rất nhiều; và ông xây trong Giu-đa các đồn lũy và các thành kho.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát ngày càng hùng mạnh, và vua xây các đồn lũy và các thành kho trong Giu-đa.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát ngày càng hùng mạnh. Vua xây các đồn lũy trong Giu-đa, và các thành để chứa lương thực và vật dụng.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 점점 더 커져서 매우 높아졌다. 그리고 그가 유다에 요새들과 국고 성읍들을 지었다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 점점 더 강해졌다. 그는 유다에 요새들과 국고 성읍들을 지었다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 점점 더 강해졌다. 그는 유다에 요새들을 짓고, 물자를 쌓아 두는 성읍들도 지었다.

decisions.choice: was going and growing great, to above: grew greater and greater
decisions.reason: "Going" with a second verb means that something kept on increasing (compare Genesis 26:13; 1 Chronicles 11:9). "To above" adds that his greatness rose very high.

decisions.choice: fortresses: strongholds or citadels
decisions.reason: The word appears only in Chronicles (here and 27:4). It names a fortified building or small fort, smaller than a walled city.

decisions.choice: cities of storage: towns where supplies were kept
decisions.reason: Solomon too had built store cities (8:4, 6). They held grain, oil, wine and weapons for the army and the court.

decisions.choice: store cities (Balanced); towns where supplies were stored (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same wording as for Solomon's store cities at 8:4 and 8:6.

en.R: He kept large supplies in the towns of Judah, and he had soldiers, brave warriors, in Jerusalem.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa na kazi nyingi katika miji ya Yuda, na watu wa vita, mashujaa hodari, katika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Alikuwa na akiba kubwa katika miji ya Yuda, na askari, wapiganaji hodari, katika Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Alihifadhi akiba kubwa katika miji ya Yuda, naye alikuwa na askari, wapiganaji jasiri, katika Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Ông có nhiều công việc trong các thành của Giu-đa, và các chiến sĩ, là dũng sĩ mạnh mẽ, tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vua có nhiều kho dự trữ trong các thành của Giu-đa, và có binh lính, là những chiến binh dũng mãnh, tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Vua cất giữ rất nhiều lương thực và vật dụng trong các thành của Giu-đa, và có binh lính là những chiến binh dũng cảm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 그에게는 유다 성읍들에 많은 일이 있었고, 예루살렘에는 군사들, 곧 힘센 용사들이 있었다.
ko.B: 그는 유다 성읍들에 많은 물자를 두었고, 예루살렘에는 군사들, 곧 힘센 용사들을 두었다.
ko.R: 그는 유다 성읍들에 많은 물자를 쌓아 두었다. 그리고 예루살렘에는 군인들, 곧 용감한 용사들이 있었다.

decisions.choice: much work: large stores of goods, or many building works
decisions.reason: The word usually means work, but it can also mean what work produces: goods and property (Exodus 22:7, 10). After the store cities of verse 12, it most likely means large supplies kept in the towns. It could also mean that he carried out many works there.

decisions.choice: men of war, mighty men of valor: trained, able soldiers
decisions.reason: "Men of war" are soldiers. "Mighty men of valor" joins "mighty man" with a word for strength and ability, as in the lists of 1 Chronicles 7:2-40. These were the troops kept in Jerusalem, listed in verses 14-18.

decisions.choice: mighty men of valor (Literal); mighty warriors (Balanced); brave warriors (Readable)
decisions.reason: One wording for this phrase at each level, as in 1 Chronicles 7.

decisions.choice: "많은 일" (L), "많은 물자" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Much work" may be stores or building works (m1); Balanced and Readable follow the English reading.

records.literal_gloss: And these [were] their musterings by [the] house of their fathers: of Judah, commanders of thousands: Adnah the commander, and with him mighty [men] of valor three hundred thousand;

en.L: And these [were] their musterings by the house of their fathers: of Judah, commanders of thousands: Adnah the commander, and with him 300,000 mighty men of valor,
en.B: This was their muster by ancestral families. From Judah, the commanders of thousands: Adnah was the commander, and he had 300,000 mighty warriors with him,
en.R: Here is the list of the soldiers by their families. From the tribe of Judah, the commanders of units of a thousand were these: Adnah was the chief commander, with 300,000 brave warriors.

es.L: Y estos [eran] sus alistados por las casas de sus padres: de Judá, jefes de millares: Adna el jefe, y con él 300 000 valientes guerreros;
es.B: Este era su censo por familias. De Judá, los jefes de millares: Adna era el jefe, y tenía con él 300 000 guerreros valientes,
es.R: Esta es la lista de los soldados por familias. De la tribu de Judá, los jefes de grupos de mil eran estos: Adna era el jefe principal, con 300 000 guerreros valientes.

fr.L: Et voici leur dénombrement selon la maison de leurs pères : de Juda, chefs de milliers : Adna le chef, et avec lui 300 000 vaillants guerriers ;
fr.B: Voici leur recensement par familles. De Juda, les chefs de milliers : Adna était le chef, et il avait avec lui 300 000 vaillants guerriers ;
fr.R: Voici la liste des soldats par familles. De la tribu de Juda, les chefs des unités de mille hommes étaient ceux-ci : Adna était le commandant en chef, avec 300 000 courageux guerriers.

sw.L: Na hii [ndiyo] hesabu yao kwa nyumba za baba zao: wa Yuda, wakuu wa maelfu: Adna mkuu, na pamoja naye mashujaa hodari 300,000,
sw.B: Hii ndiyo hesabu yao kwa jamaa zao. Kutoka Yuda, makamanda wa maelfu: Adna alikuwa kamanda, na pamoja naye wapiganaji hodari 300,000,
sw.R: Hii ndiyo orodha ya askari kwa jamaa zao. Kutoka kabila la Yuda, makamanda wa vikosi vya askari elfu walikuwa hawa: Adna alikuwa kamanda mkuu, akiwa na wapiganaji jasiri 300,000.

vi.L: Đây [là] sự kiểm tra quân số của họ theo nhà tổ phụ họ: thuộc Giu-đa, các chỉ huy hàng ngàn: Át-na làm chỉ huy, và với ông có 300.000 dũng sĩ mạnh mẽ,
vi.B: Đây là quân số của họ theo từng gia tộc. Từ Giu-đa có các chỉ huy ngàn quân: Át-na làm tướng chỉ huy, có 300.000 chiến binh dũng mãnh dưới quyền,
vi.R: Đây là danh sách binh lính theo từng gia đình. Từ chi tộc Giu-đa có các chỉ huy các đơn vị ngàn quân như sau: Át-na làm tướng chỉ huy, với 300.000 chiến binh dũng cảm.

ko.L: 그리고 이것은 그들의 조상 가문별로 등록된 수이다. 유다에서는 천부장들, 곧 지휘관 아드나와 그와 함께한 힘센 용사 30만 명,
ko.B: 그들을 조상 가문별로 등록한 명단은 이러하다. 유다에서는 천부장들이 있었는데, 지휘관 아드나가 힘센 용사 30만 명을 거느렸고,
ko.R: 군인들을 집안별로 적은 명단은 이러하다. 유다 지파에서는 천 명씩 거느리는 지휘관들이 있었다. 총지휘관 아드나는 용감한 용사 30만 명을 거느렸다.

decisions.choice: their musterings: the men counted and enrolled for service
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb used for counting soldiers for war (Numbers 1:3). It names the troops as they were registered, family by family.

decisions.choice: commanders of thousands; the commander: the army's officers, with Adnah at the head
decisions.reason: The army was organized in units of thousands and hundreds (Exodus 18:21; Numbers 31:14). Adnah, called "the commander", is first in rank; the next verses name the men ranked after him.

decisions.choice: three hundred thousand: the word read as the number "thousand"
decisions.reason: As in the census lists of Numbers (see the note at Numbers 1:21), the word for "thousand" could also name a military or clan unit, which would give much smaller figures. The totals in verses 14-18 come to 1,160,000, twice the size of Asa's army (14:7).

decisions.choice: ancestral families (Balanced); families (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording used for "house of their fathers" through Chronicles.

decisions.choice: units of a thousand
decisions.reason: Readable explains "commanders of thousands" as leaders of units, as at 1 Chronicles 26:26.

decisions.choice: "nhà tổ phụ" (L); "gia tộc" (B); "gia đình" (R); "chỉ huy hàng ngàn" (L), "chỉ huy ngàn quân" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording for "house of their fathers" and "commanders of thousands" kept from 1:2.

vi.R: Kế đến là Giê-hô-ha-nan, với 280.000 người.

decisions.choice: at his hand: next to him in rank
decisions.reason: "At his hand" means beside him, and in a list of officers it marks the next in order (compare Numbers 2:20). Jehohanan ranks after Adnah.

decisions.choice: thousand: as in verse 14

en.B: next to him was Amasiah son of Zichri, who had volunteered himself for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and with him 200,000 mighty warriors.
en.R: Next was Amasiah son of Zichri, who had freely offered himself to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He had 200,000 brave warriors with him.

fr.B: à côté de lui, Amasia, fils de Zikri, qui s’était offert volontairement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et avec lui 200 000 vaillants guerriers.

sw.R: Aliyefuata alikuwa Amasia mwana wa Zikri, aliyekuwa amejitolea kwa hiari kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alikuwa na wapiganaji jasiri 200,000.

vi.L: và bên cạnh ông [là] A-ma-sia con trai Xiếc-ri, người tình nguyện dâng mình cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và với ông có 200.000 dũng sĩ mạnh mẽ.

ko.L: 그의 곁에 자기를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 즐거이 바친 시그리의 아들 아마시야와 그와 함께한 힘센 용사 20만 명이었다.
ko.B: 그다음은 자원하여 자기를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 시그리의 아들 아마시야인데, 힘센 용사 20만 명을 거느렸다.
ko.R: 그다음은 시그리의 아들 아마시야였다. 그는 기꺼이 자기를 바쳐 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 사람이었다. 그는 용감한 용사 20만 명을 거느렸다.

decisions.choice: who volunteered himself for Yahweh: offered himself freely to Yahweh's service
decisions.reason: The verb means to act willingly, without being forced. It is used of people who came forward for battle (Judges 5:2, 9) and of gifts given freely for the temple (1 Chronicles 29:5-9). Amasiah is remembered for giving himself freely, perhaps for war, perhaps in some special act of devotion to Yahweh; the text does not say more.

decisions.choice: thousand: as in verse 14
decisions.reason: As in verse 14.

decisions.choice: freely offered himself to serve
decisions.reason: Readable explains "volunteered himself for" with plain words that keep the sense of a free choice.

decisions.choice: Benjamin: the tribe joined to Judah
decisions.reason: Benjamin stayed with Judah under the kings of David's line (11:1, 12). Under Asa too the men of Benjamin were archers who carried shields (14:7).

decisions.choice: armed with bow: men who handled the bow
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of archers (1 Chronicles 12:2). With the shield, it describes lightly armed troops who could shoot and also protect themselves.

decisions.choice: men
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "men", which the Hebrew leaves to be understood. Literal puts the name before the description, for clearer English.

records.literal_gloss: These [were] the ones serving the king, besides [those] whom put the king in [the] cities of the fortification in all Judah.

en.L: These [were] those who served the king, besides those whom the king had put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
en.B: These were the men who served the king, besides those he had stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.
en.R: These men served the king. There were also the soldiers the king had placed in the walled towns all over Judah.

es.L: Estos [eran] los que servían al rey, aparte de los que el rey había puesto en las ciudades fortificadas en todo Judá.
es.B: Estos eran los que servían al rey, además de los que había puesto en las ciudades fortificadas por todo Judá.
es.R: Estos hombres servían al rey. Además estaban los soldados que el rey había puesto en los pueblos amurallados por todo Judá.

fr.L: Ceux-là [étaient] ceux qui servaient le roi, sans compter ceux que le roi avait mis dans les villes fortes de tout Juda.
fr.B: Tels étaient les hommes qui servaient le roi, sans compter ceux qu’il avait placés dans les villes fortes de tout Juda.
fr.R: Ces hommes servaient le roi. Il y avait aussi les soldats que le roi avait placés dans les villes fortifiées de tout Juda.

vi.L: Đó [là] những người phục vụ vua, ngoài những người vua đã đặt trong các thành kiên cố khắp cả Giu-đa.

vi.R: Những người này phục vụ vua. Ngoài ra còn có những binh lính vua đã đặt trong các thành có tường bao quanh khắp Giu-đa.

ko.B: 이들은 왕을 섬기는 사람들이었다. 그 밖에도 왕이 온 유다의 요새 성읍들에 배치한 군인들이 있었다.
ko.R: 이 사람들이 왕을 섬겼다. 그 밖에도 왕이 유다 곳곳의 성벽으로 둘러싸인 성읍들에 둔 군인들이 있었다.

decisions.choice: those who served the king: the troops of verses 14-18
decisions.reason: "These" points back to the commanders and their men listed in verses 14-18, the forces at the king's call, linked with the warriors in Jerusalem (verse 13).

decisions.choice: besides those in the fortified cities: the garrisons of verse 2
decisions.reason: The troops in the walled towns, placed there at the start of his reign (verse 2), are counted apart from these. The chapter ends as it began, with the king's strength in his fortified cities.

decisions.choice: walled towns
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.
